prompt: In ICD-10-CM, codes are generally reported to the highest level of specificity supported by documentation. What does that mean?

explanation: ICD-10-CM guidelines require coding to the highest specificity supported by the record; truncating without reason can cause denials.

distractorExplanations.b: Confuses categories with billable codes: a three-character category is reported only when it has no further subdivision.
distractorExplanations.c: Unspecified codes are for when documentation lacks detail, not a convenience default when specific detail is documented.
distractorExplanations.d: Signs and symptoms routinely associated with a confirmed diagnosis are integral to it and are not coded separately.
